class.name: HEGoLog
class.brief_description: HEGo's logger, shared by the C++ side and GDScript.
class.description:
Everything HEGo logs goes through this singleton. Each entry carries a level, a category and a timestamp, and ends up in an in-memory buffer the HEGo bottom panel reads, in the Godot output if it is at or above the output level, and in a log file if file logging is enabled.
Log your own messages through the same object so they appear alongside HEGo's: [codeblock] var log = HEGoLog.get_singleton() log.info("cook", "Cooking %s" % asset_name) log.warning("input", "Input %s has no mesh, skipping it." % path) [/codeblock]
Recording is safe from any thread. HEGo's work runs on a background thread (see [HEGoTask]), so entries are recorded wherever they are produced and printed later on the main thread; nothing in the logging path calls into Godot from a worker thread.
Warnings and errors also go through [code]push_warning()[/code] and [code]push_error()[/code], so they still reach Godot's debugger.
Configured through the [code]hego/logging/[/code] project settings: [code]store_level[/code], [code]output_level[/code], [code]enable_file_logging[/code], [code]log_path[/code] and [code]max_log_files[/code].

method.name: get_singleton
method.description: Returns the global [HEGoLog] instance.

method.name: level_name
method.description: Human readable name of a level, for example [code]"WARNING"[/code] for [constant LEVEL_WARNING].

method.name: trace
method.description: Records a per-element detail message. Dropped unless [code]hego/logging/store_level[/code] is lowered to [constant LEVEL_TRACE].

method.name: debug
method.description: Records what HEGo is doing during a cook. Goes to the session panel and the log file, not to the Godot output, unless the output level is lowered.

method.name: info
method.description: Records a milestone worth showing to the user: session started, cook finished, asset selected.

method.name: warning
method.description: Records that something was skipped or guessed while the operation continued. Also raises a Godot warning.

method.name: error
method.description: Records that an operation failed. Also raises a Godot error.

method.name: log_message
method.description: Records a message at an explicit level, for callers that decide the level at runtime.

method.name: get_cursor
method.description: Index one past the newest entry. Pass a previously returned value to [method get_entries_since] to read only what arrived in between.

method.name: get_entries_since
method.description:
Entries recorded since [code]cursor[/code], as dictionaries with [code]index[/code], [code]time[/code], [code]level[/code], [code]level_name[/code], [code]category[/code] and [code]message[/code].
Entries dropped from the buffer since then are simply missing, so a reader that falls behind skips ahead rather than blocking anything.

method.name: get_categories
method.description: Categories seen since the buffer was last cleared. HEGo uses [code]session[/code], [code]node[/code], [code]cook[/code], [code]input[/code], [code]output[/code], [code]attrib[/code], [code]parm[/code], [code]terrain3d[/code] and [code]platform[/code]; your own scripts may use any string.

method.name: clear
method.description: Empties the buffer.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes the whole buffer to [code]path[/code] as text. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file could not be written.

method.name: flush
method.description: Prints everything recorded since the last call to the Godot output and the log file. Must run on the main thread; the editor plugin calls it every frame, so most callers never need to.

method.name: get_log_file_path
method.description: Absolute path of the log file this run writes to, or an empty string when file logging is off.

method.name: configure
method.description: Re-reads the [code]hego/logging/[/code] project settings and reopens the log file. Call after changing any of them at runtime.

method.name: set_store_level
method.description: Lowest level kept in the buffer.

method.name: get_store_level
method.description: Lowest level kept in the buffer.

method.name: set_output_level
method.description: Lowest level printed to the Godot output.

method.name: get_output_level
method.description: Lowest level printed to the Godot output.

constants.constant: Per-element detail. Not recorded unless the store level is lowered to it.
What HEGo is doing during a cook. The default store level.
Milestones a user cares about. The default output level.
Something was skipped or guessed; the operation continues.
